name: Service desk
description: Service desk handles the end-of-day office work at Ferncliff Home Services, a plumbing, heating and electrical company with twelve technicians and about 400 customers. It prices finished jobs into invoices, works out overdue balances after partial payments, and books new service requests into the earliest open technician slot. It works from the company records (customers, technicians, rates, parts, jobs, invoices, payments, bookings, open requests, travel times and city tax rates, all CSV files) and follows the rules in policy.md. It only writes to invoices.csv and bookings.csv.
summary: Bills finished jobs, chases overdue balances and books technicians from the office records.
does: Works out overdue balances after partial payments
Books the earliest slot a qualified technician has
Follows the rounding and tax rules in the policy
doesNot: Never changes past invoices or payments
Asks before it saves an invoice or a booking

taskTypes.label: Invoices
taskTypes.description: Price a finished job and add its invoice.

taskTypes.label: Overdue balances
taskTypes.description: Find overdue invoices and balances after partial payments, for one customer or a group.

taskTypes.label: Scheduling
taskTypes.description: Book a service request into the earliest feasible slot in the customer's window.

files.name: policy.md
files.description: Office rules: pricing, tax, rounding, invoice numbering, payment terms, overdue balances and scheduling.

files.name: customers.csv
files.description: One row per customer: name, city (sets the tax rate), zone (sets the trip fee and travel), plan_member and terms_days.

files.name: technicians.csv
files.description: The twelve technicians: tier, skills, licenses, work_days, and daily start_time and end_time.

files.name: rates.csv
files.description: Hourly labor rate in cents for each technician tier.

files.name: parts.csv
files.description: Parts and pass-through fees: unit cost in cents, markup percent, and whether taxable.

files.name: jobs.csv
files.description: Finished jobs: customer, technician, date, the work done, minutes on site, and whether it was after hours.

files.name: job_parts.csv
files.description: The parts used on each job, with quantities.

files.name: invoices.csv
files.description: Every invoice issued so far, amounts in cents. New invoices go here.

files.name: payments.csv
files.description: Payments against invoices, in cents. Some are dated after the business date.

files.name: requests.csv
files.description: Open service requests waiting for a booking: skill, license needed, duration, earliest date and the time window the customer asked for.

files.name: bookings.csv
files.description: Technician bookings from the business date on. New bookings go here.

files.name: travel.csv
files.description: Driving minutes between service zones, including within the same zone.

files.name: tax.csv
files.description: Sales tax rate for each city, in basis points (825 means 8.25%).
